limits: These are isolated same-image Android35 prerequisites. They do not establish ordinary-game or Android-device parity.
The native diagnostic battle uses the earlier modeled platform; this linker is not integrated into a complete game process.
The missing-library fatal is preserved; no game assertion, native fatal branch, library record, or success result is patched.
Original kernel process inputs remain explicitly supplied. Completing one startup path will not prove every Android runtime behavior.
